Rural Urban Classification

Description

This data element identifies the classification of the segment of the trafficway on which the crash occurred based on FHWA-approved adjusted Census boundaries of small urban and urbanized areas.

Notes

From 1975 to 1986 there was a similar Land Use (LAND_USE) data element. From 1987 to 2014 urban and rural classifications can be obtained from the data element Roadway Function Class. Prior to 2023 this data element’s name was “Land Use.”
